title: Laplace and Dolbeault operators on Sasakian manifolds
summary: Sasakian manifolds, the odd-dimensional analogues of Kähler manifolds, carry two natural pairs of first-order Dolbeault-type operators on the full complex of differential forms, extending the Kohn--Rossi differentials. On such Sasaki manifolds, we establish Kähler-type identities for these operators, and relate the resulting Dolbeault Laplacians to the Hodge Laplacian. Unlike the Kähler case, where $Δ=2Δ_{\overline\partial}$, the relation has extra terms coming from the Reeb flow.
